original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: Construct and exact-check tagged direct-sum rank-two interfaces for 753 pairs of codimension-one frame transitions in the selected width-73 complex word: 574 shared A/B gate pairs, 16 scheduled cleanup pairs, and 163 deterministic terminal pairs.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card is broad. This isolates a new cross-register child boundary that is absent from the frozen per-register frame interface and owner catalogue. The local experiment demonstrates exact two-lane maps and a greater-than-5% favorable fixed-word ceiling shift, while explicitly leaving physical realization and the new recursive supplier contract open.
bottleneck_link: The selected complex side is capped by many rank-one children. Replacing two rank-one charges by one rank-two charge improves the exact local ceiling 5.24% under zero added interface overhead, but the 1/99 target still fails and no kappa is claimed.
stop_rule: Enumerate the complete pinned local word: all A/B gate transitions, all scheduled early-cleanup transitions, and all terminal frames. Pair each same-gate 1+1 climb and the terminal rank-one set by increasing register id. Stop after exact replay, profile pricing, four negative controls, and package checks; do not search alternate pairing policies in this cycle.
evidence: The exact source profile {1:2412,2:418,3:432,4:142,5:82,8:8} replays on decompressed word SHA256 c2b294300760e1fd6eeab8c22c4d13e4633dca40e52cac8da0d68163a76e3ca8. The recipe contains 753 verified tagged rank-two boundaries and yields virtual profile {1:906,2:1171,3:432,4:142,5:82,8:8}, with rank mass 5,586 unchanged. The exact repository ceiling routine brackets the baseline and candidate ceilings and proves at least a 5.241623654% ideal gain; the candidate relaxation at a=1/99 remains greater than one. The 5% margin permits at most 11 additional rank-one local children per call when charged against fractional rank-51 idle mass; 12 miss the margin. Four semantic negative controls reject. Physical J2 admission, copies, hosting, restoration, and phase/precision costs remain open.
